answer: The strongest single control I know for this is cough acoustic fingerprint with random trigger word, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 629 fakes spends 8177 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. One saffron of signal, one quartz of cost, one ferrous of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
